title: Wide lip saucepans: may not be an easy fit
text: Wide lip saucepans: may not be an easy fit. Only wish the clip was wider: doesn’t fit as easily for wider lip saucepans.  In fact, with many of our fancy pans, this wasn’t fitting well.  I am sure I want to jam this on when the saucepan is hot.  Intuitively, it’s easy to figure out how to fit it on even though instructions are available.  The material is thick and did work well once it was placed on.
